integrity_statement: A complete finite-parameter proof accompanies exactly reproducible finite checks. The result has undergone same-model review only; no independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only independent homogeneous G(n,p), integers n≥r+1 and r≥3, and 0<p<1 are covered. No correlation estimates, limit laws, or fixed-edge results. Generic motif-overlap formulas may already implicitly imply this specialization, although the uniform sign diagram was not identified in the inspected material.
title: A sharp density and motif-size crossover for triangle–induced-star covariance
